arguments.command:
cd test/fixtures/extensions/durable-ask && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
p='package.json'
d=json.load(open(p))
d['pi']['prompts']=["./prompts"]
open(p,'w').write(json.dumps(d,indent='\t')+"\n")
EOF
mkdir -p prompts && cat > prompts/ship.md <<'EOF'
---
description: Ship a release
argument-hint: <version> [notes...]
---
Ship version $1 with notes: ${@:2}
EOF
cat package.json; cd - >/dev/null; git diff --stat
